entities.summary: Gabriel Calloet de Querbrat, was born at an unknown date between 1616 and 1620 in Kerbrat-en-Servel, and died in Lannion on June 30, 1697 aged around 80. He was a Breton Catholic agriculturist and writer. Considered to have introduced the idea of zootechnical improvement through cross-breeding to France, he played an important role in the establishment of hôpitaux généraux in the seventeenth century.
